mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals an inflationary environment that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market characterized by low unemployment and strong job growth, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overheating concerns, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition (UNRATE<5.0% and PAYEMS growth>0.5% monthly), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by more than 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level indicates stronger manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 115, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
